authority_effect: Adoption and lock require exact bytes; activation does not authorize implementation unless separately stated.
change_treatment: Material amendment requires successor; historical bytes preserved.
closure_treatment: Closure requires source, lifecycle, findings, accession/custody, retained-risk treatment.

purpose: Product/domain design authority subordinate to canon and Founder directives.
authority_owner: Founder or delegated product governance authority
authority_effect: May guide design after adoption; no implementation authority by itself.
change_treatment: Partial supersession must identify surviving provisions.
closure_treatment: PIA closure requires source identity or certified historical exception plus retained findings.

purpose: Sequencing, dependency, mapping, and work-package coordination.
authority_owner: Founder, implementation governance owner, or delegated authority
authority_effect: Planning authority only unless exact implementation authorization exists.
change_treatment: Material sequencing or authority changes require successor or amendment record.
closure_treatment: Closure requires no unowned blockers inside scope or explicit exclusions.

purpose: Engineering interpretation and practice within activated scope.
authority_effect: No implementation mapping, activation, or runtime effect unless separately authorized.
change_treatment: Material guide changes require versioned successor and reactivation analysis.
closure_treatment: Guide closure does not equal activation or blocker closure.

purpose: Bounded architectural or technical decision record.
change_treatment: New consequence or contradiction requires successor ADR.
closure_treatment: Closure requires decision scope, authority, consequences, retained risk.

authority_effect: Subordinate to constitutional governance; this package remains candidate until adopted and activated.
change_treatment: Material amendments require controlled versioning; lock optional by Founder decision.
closure_treatment: Documentary completion is not adoption, lock, or activation.

purpose: Controlled rows recording current-state facts, lifecycle, findings, or decisions.
authority_effect: Evidentiary or control record only unless its controlling source grants authority.
change_treatment: Rows are corrected, superseded, or tombstoned; not silently overwritten.
closure_treatment: Closure requires all in-scope rows reconciled or explicitly retained.

purpose: Repeatable operational execution within approved authority.
authority_effect: May direct execution only inside existing authority.
change_treatment: Operational changes versioned; emergency changes get retrospective review.
closure_treatment: Readiness claims require rehearsal or certified substitute evidence.

purpose: Proof of fact, test, state, review, integration, or custody event.
authority_effect: Evidence cannot create authority by itself.
change_treatment: Corrections create addenda or successor evidence packages.
closure_treatment: Closure requires manifest, checksum, scope, and limitation validation.

purpose: Telemetry, observations, outcomes, incidents, support records, and review data produced during controlled pilot activity.
authority_effect: May substitute for planned evidence only through Founder interpretation and recorded scope.
change_treatment: Contradictions trigger review rather than deletion.
closure_treatment: Closure requires environment, build, cohort, duration, feature/data scope, provenance, anomalies, metrics, and substitute requirement mapping.

purpose: Durable authority to grant, withhold, narrow, or condition action.
authority_effect: Only exact authority named by directive exists.
change_treatment: Clarifying or successor directive required for expansion.
closure_treatment: Closure requires authorized actions complete and prohibited actions untouched.

purpose: Evidence that exact expected bytes exist at protected repository state.
authority_effect: Custody is evidentiary and does not create activation or production authority.
change_treatment: Incorrect receipts require corrective receipt preserving historical fact.
closure_treatment: Closure requires protected head, path, hash, byte length, and receipt validation.
